name: Gaia GUSD
notes: Gaia launch announcement reviewed; distinct Gaia USD-backed stablecoin identity and Bridge-powered launch are established. Issuer legal entity, reserve composition, redemption and exact deployment require source-bounded review.

name: SBC
notes: Visa primary source reviewed; SBC is a U.S.-dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Brale and natively supported on Canton. Public availability, reserve composition, holder redemption and control details remain unresolved.

name: Movement USDCx
notes: Circle primary source reviewed; USDCx is available on Movement, deployed by Movement and fully backed 1:1 by USDC held in Circle xReserve. Circle publishes the Movement mainnet token address.

name: USDU
notes: Universal primary source reviewed; 2026-01-29 launch, Universal Digital Intl Limited issuer role, CBUAE registration, FSRA permission, 1:1 USD safeguarded reserves at Emirates NBD and Mashreq, monthly independent attestation and Professional Client scope are established.

name: USDKG
notes: USDKG official site and OSL listing source reviewed; physical-gold backing and institutional redemption are described, but exact authorized issuing legal entity is still unresolved and will not be guessed.

name: litUSD
notes: Stably launch case study reviewed; litUSD launched on Ethereum in August 2025, is issued by Brale, backed 1:1 by cash and cash equivalents, and mintable/redeemable at parity by verified Brale users. Exact launch day and contract identity require additional primary capture.

name: MetaMask USD
notes: MetaMask primary sources reviewed; mUSD launched in September 2025, is issued by Bridge and powered by M0, backed 1:1 by short-term U.S. Treasury bills, and supported on Ethereum Mainnet and Linea.
